acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Notion has a Free plan at $0 per member per month. It works well for an individual, but collaborative blocks are limited for workspaces with two or more members and each Free-plan file upload is limited to 5 MB.

Yes, but only in the desktop and mobile apps. Pages must be downloaded for offline use. Paid plans also auto-download recently visited and favorited pages. The offline feature is not available in a web browser.
Free and Plus include a limited AI trial. Business and Enterprise include Notion AI features such as Notion Agent and AI Meeting Notes. Custom Agents use Notion credits after the free trial.

mainEntity.name: Can Notion replace project management software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion can handle project databases, tasks, subtasks, dependencies and several views. Teams that need deeper task controls, time tracking, sprint planning or workload reporting may prefer a dedicated project tool such as ClickUp.
